analysis_note: Constructs overlap by design. They summarize which user-valued capability each case exercises; they are not independent subscales.

right_problem_framing.label: Right-problem framing
right_problem_framing.description: Distinguishes a proposed solution from the human situation, develops credible alternative frames, and lets contradictory evidence change the frame.

structured_divergence_and_synthesis.label: Structured divergence and synthesis
structured_divergence_and_synthesis.description: Creates conceptual distance, organizes alternatives, preserves contradictions and outliers, and avoids premature convergence.

evidence_discipline.label: Evidence discipline
evidence_discipline.description: Separates evidence, inference, assumptions, synthetic signals, and unknowns while identifying the grounding needed for a consequential decision.

learning_and_iteration.label: Learning-oriented experiments and iteration
learning_and_iteration.description: Chooses a proportionate prototype or inquiry, defines decision-relevant signals, and updates direction when evidence changes.

appropriate_scope.label: Appropriate scope and momentum
appropriate_scope.description: Uses Design Thinking when it adds decision value and proceeds directly when requirements or a cheap technical experiment are already clear.
